findings.mechanism: functools.lru_cache on the method category_totals is a module-level cache keyed by (self, account, month); it pins the builder and the cached tuples.
findings.evidence: Ran 30000 requests through load.run with tracemalloc, gc.collect between 5000-request batches: traced heap stayed ~147-150 KB (about +0.5 KB per batch, noise). cache_info shows currsize pinned at 128 with 24000 misses and 0 hits (the access pattern never repeats within 128 entries, so the cache is useless but capped).
findings.discriminator: cache currsize is capped at maxsize=128 and traced memory is flat across 30000 requests

findings.mechanism: ReportBuilder._columns lists are filled on each render and held by the long-lived builder.
findings.cause: buffers are cleared at the start of every render() (line 29-30), so they hold at most one report's rows
findings.evidence: Same tracemalloc run: no growth across batches, including 1/5 detail requests.
findings.discriminator: column.clear() on every render bounds the lists to a single report; heap is flat
